question: We're writing a piece on F1's younger generation and want a number for it: how many drivers born in 1976 or later (born from 1 January 1976 onwards) have ever set the second-fastest lap of a race at any point in the history covered by the data? I just need the single count of such drivers.
evidence: By second-fastest lap of a race I mean the driver's own fastest lap in that race was the second quickest among all drivers in that race.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.driverId) AS driver_count FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.dob) >= '1976' AND T1.rank = 2

expected.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.driverId) AS driver_count FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.dob) >= '1976' AND T1.rank = 2
expected.evidence: By second-fastest lap of a race I mean the driver's own fastest lap in that race was the second quickest among all drivers in that race.
